title: Transition from Sites to GALX Images with Public Masonry Stream
author: maintainer
description: Elevated GALX Images as primary flagship product due to high technical and quota overhead of Sites. Images are public by default. Created Pinterest-style public masonry stream with keyset pagination (/api/images/feed), interactive card overlays, prompt copying, download, and lightbox modal. Redesigned homepage hero with fast prompt composer, updated navigation and mobile bottom nav, and redirected legacy /sites routes to /images.

verification.feed_api: GET /api/images/feed (HTTP 200, valid keyset pagination and public allowlist DTO)
